title: Bound on Total Argument Segment Length
statement: Let $ws$ be a finite list of bit strings, and suppose every string in $ws$ has length at most $W$. Form argument segments by marking each word for doubling except the final word, which is left undoubled. The sum of the segment lengths, counting doubled words twice, is at most $|ws|\,(2W)$.
hypotheses_covered: $ws$ is a finite list of bit strings
each word in $ws$ has length at most $W$
